title: Code export input
description: Generate framework-specific code from a validated UiSchema. A workflow schema generates a runnable React or Vue application with navigation, local store and deterministic sample data.

dslVersion.description: DSL version to use for this request. Defaults to the current version (1.0).

schema.description: A structurally valid UiSchema tree to generate code from. UiElement.state branches are checked against the canonical workflow-state vocabulary by the state-contract gate.

schemaRef.description: Reference to a cached UiSchema returned by design.compose.

framework.description: Target framework for code generation. HTML delegates to the `repl` tool's `render` action (document mode).

profile.description: Validation profile. draft reports non-structural target/contract gaps, including workflow-state contract gaps, as warnings; build is the default runnable-artifact gate; release additionally requires hash-bound evidence.

releaseEvidence.description: Evidence for release. All six named classes are required by the release gate and must bind to the generated artifact contentHash.

theme.description: Application and embedded chart theme. Workflow shells set this scope on html and body, including at mount.

brand.description: Token brand shared by the generated shell and embedded charts.

typescript.description: When true, emit TypeScript prop types (React) or typed defineProps (Vue). Ignored for HTML.

styling.description: React/Vue styling strategy: inline style objects, design-token CSS variables, or Tailwind utility classes. HTML uses document CSS; requesting Tailwind reports OODS-N018 as a draft warning or a build/release error.

artifactContentHash.description: Exact generated artifact hash inspected by this evidence.

reference.description: Stable report, trace, or artifact reference.
